A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (11 September 2025). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:OTSD-D-obsidiansquadrontie-PC-2025-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Obsidian Squadron TIE (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (by 18 August 2019): Same words as the disc card.

The whole disc card image and the whole D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
